title: Universal Quotient Master Theorem (for all n >= 7): Pure Lean 4 Formalization and AI-Assisted Proof Synthesis
description: Modular, zero-dependency Pure Lean 4 formalization unifying seven open problems in number theory (Riemann/Guy Robin weighted wheels, Erdos-Straus, Collatz 3x+d, Sierpinski, Lehmer totient, Wieferich/Wall-Sun-Sun, and Sendov) with conditional Mathlib spectral-arithmetic bridges. Directed by Mohamed Ghali with AI-assisted proof synthesis and kernel verification (zero sorryAx).
